quest.title: Akitsu Yuugei
quest.description: Both Ei and Heizou mentioned this mysterious game. Go to the beach and check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Akitsu Yuugei... Both Ei and Heizou mentioned that game before. Shall we check it out?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be where people play Akitsu Yuugei. This place seems to be opening back up, just like Ei said.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't really see anyone here though... Heizou said that we can start the game by talking to the Bulletin Board, so Paimon thinks we should try that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should still be careful though. Paimon really doesn't want to be trapped here!
